name: compact-inspector-pane
title: Compact Inspector Pane
description: CAD/3D modeling application layout: scene tree on left, canvas in center, and property inspector on right.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Cad Three Pane Inspector: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
